notes: Authoritative parsing inventory for the BBH Study Tool. Hand-maintained against Cook & Holmstedt (page images); never generated. js/data/bbh_parsing.js is generated FROM this file by tools/gen_bbh_parsing_data.mjs.
Every form: exactly one of introducedLesson (1-50) or appendixOnly:true. Cumulative lesson gate; appendix-only forms sit behind an off-by-default toggle.
acceptedParses is always an array; every morphologically legitimate parse of the written form that the source supports must be listed. ambiguityNote explains context-dependence.

Hebrew axes only. Verb: binyan, conjugation, person, gender, number, suffix. Nominal: gender, number, state, suffix. Pronoun: person, gender, number (+ deixis for demonstratives). No tense/voice/mood/case keys - the validator hard-fails on them.
display is the pointed form and is authoritative; compare/unpointed fields are derived at generation time only.
source: {"lesson": N, "page": N} for lesson-introduced material, {"appendix": "A|B|C", "page": "a-N"} for appendix material. PDF mapping: printed page = PDF page (lessons); a-N = PDF 140+N.
Populated in Phase 2 PR B from verified page images. Empty in PR A by design (schema + engine land before content).
